messages.subject: Time recording reminder — December narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Our records show 14.5 hours of unposted time across the team for December with missing narratives. Please ask the team to complete their narratives by Friday so we can finalise the January bills. The monthly WIP report is attached for your matters.

Thanks,
Accounts
